title.en: Drag-Chain Cable
title.zh: 拖链电缆

subtitle.en: Design the cable, carrier and motion profile as one system
subtitle.zh: 把线缆、拖链与运动谱作为一个系统设计

lead.en: For robots, CNC axes, gantries and automated equipment, repeated flexing must be defined before conductor, jacket or shield selection.
lead.zh: 面向机器人、CNC 轴、龙门与自动化设备，必须先定义重复弯曲工况，再选择导体、护套与屏蔽结构。

intro.en: A drag-chain cable is not identified by softness alone. Travel, speed, acceleration, bend radius, cycle count, orientation, fill and environmental exposure create the real duty. The cable carrier controls the path, but it does not remove tensile, torsional or abrasion loads caused by poor installation.
intro.zh: 拖链电缆不能只凭“柔软”判断。行程、速度、加速度、弯曲半径、循环次数、安装方向、填充率与环境暴露共同构成真实工况。拖链负责约束路径，但不能消除错误安装造成的拉伸、扭转或磨损。

title.en: Define the motion before choosing the cable
title.zh: 先定义运动，再选择线缆

copy.en: Record travel length, cycle rate, acceleration, operating hours, minimum dynamic bend radius and whether the path is horizontal, vertical or unsupported. Continuous flexing and torsion are different loads: a robot wrist, linear axis and festoon system may require different conductor lay and reinforcement. A supplier cycle claim is meaningful only when its radius, speed, travel and installation conditions resemble the project.
copy.zh: 应记录行程、循环频率、加速度、工作时长、最小动态弯曲半径，以及路径属于水平、垂直还是悬空。连续弯曲与扭转是两种不同负载；机器人手腕、直线轴和悬挂系统可能需要不同的导体绞合与加强结构。供应商循环寿命数据只有在半径、速度、行程和安装条件接近项目时才有意义。

title.en: Fine-stranded conductors need a coordinated core lay
title.zh: 细绞导体还需要协调的缆芯绞合

copy.en: High strand count can improve flexibility, but conductor class alone does not define flex life. Insulation wall, core lay length, separators, fillers, shield construction and jacket must move together without concentrating strain. Power, servo, encoder, Ethernet and sensor circuits may share a carrier while requiring different pair geometry, shielding and current capacity. Hybrid constructions should be reviewed by circuit rather than described as one generic robot cable.
copy.zh: 较高股数可以改善柔性，但导体等级本身不能定义弯曲寿命。绝缘壁厚、缆芯节距、隔离层、填充、屏蔽与护套必须协同运动，避免应变集中。动力、伺服、编码器、工业以太网和传感器回路可能共用一条拖链，却需要不同的线对几何、屏蔽和载流能力。混合结构应按回路逐项审核，不能笼统称为“机器人电缆”。

title.en: Carrier layout controls service life
title.zh: 拖链内部布置直接影响寿命

copy.en: Keep cables free to move along the neutral axis, separate very different diameters or weights, and avoid crossing or tightly bundling adjacent runs. Observe the carrier maker’s bend radius, internal height, separators and fill guidance. Provide strain relief at the fixed and moving ends without clamping the flex zone. Hose, pneumatic line and cable interaction should be checked through the complete travel before releasing the assembly.
copy.zh: 线缆应能沿中性轴自由移动，不同直径或重量的线缆应适当分隔，避免交叉或紧密捆扎。需要遵循拖链厂商对弯曲半径、内部高度、隔片和填充率的要求。固定端与运动端应设置应力释放，但不能夹住动态弯曲区。气管、液压管与电缆之间的相互作用应在全行程内确认。

title.en: Jacket and shield follow the installed environment
title.zh: 护套与屏蔽必须服从安装环境

copy.en: PUR, TPE and other jacket compounds are selected against abrasion, oil, coolant, chips, temperature and cleaning agents, not by material name alone. A braided or foil shield must remain electrically useful after repeated motion; drain-wire fatigue and poor 360-degree termination can interrupt the EMC path. Confirm outer diameter, surface friction, cable weight and connector exit direction as part of the moving assembly.
copy.zh: PUR、TPE 等护套材料应根据磨损、油液、冷却液、切屑、温度和清洗剂选择，不能只看材料名称。编织或铝箔屏蔽在重复运动后仍需保持电气作用；排流线疲劳和不完整的 360° 端接会破坏 EMC 路径。外径、表面摩擦、线缆重量与连接器出线方向都应纳入运动组件审核。

title.en: Validate the actual cycle and inspect the failure mode
title.zh: 按真实循环验证，并检查失效模式

copy.en: Prototype testing should reproduce the intended bend radius, travel, speed, acceleration, temperature and cable loading. Continuity monitoring can reveal intermittent opens, while conductor resistance, insulation, shield continuity and visual checks identify progressive damage. Record fixture geometry and cycle count so a later cable, terminal or route change can be assessed. General flexible-cable standards do not automatically certify a project-specific drag-chain life.
copy.zh: 样件试验应复现预定弯曲半径、行程、速度、加速度、温度与载荷。在线导通监测可发现瞬断，导体电阻、绝缘、屏蔽连续性与外观检查则用于识别渐进损伤。应记录夹具几何与循环次数，便于后续线材、端接或路径变化时重新评估。通用柔性电缆标准不会自动证明某个项目的拖链寿命。

inputs.en: Travel, bend radius, speed, acceleration and cycle target
inputs.zh: 行程、弯曲半径、速度、加速度与循环目标

inputs.en: Circuit list, current, voltage, data protocol and shield plan
inputs.zh: 回路表、电流、电压、数据协议与屏蔽方案

inputs.en: Carrier size, fill, orientation, environment and endpoints
inputs.zh: 拖链尺寸、填充、方向、环境与两端接口

q.en: Is a flexible cable automatically suitable for a drag chain?
q.zh: 柔性电缆是否自动适合拖链？

a.en: No. Repeated-flex life depends on the complete construction and the actual bend radius, travel, speed, acceleration, installation and environment.
a.zh: 不是。重复弯曲寿命取决于完整结构，以及真实弯曲半径、行程、速度、加速度、安装与环境。

title.en: Flame-Retardant Cable
title.zh: 阻燃电线电缆

subtitle.en: Specify the fire test, cable arrangement and acceptance evidence
subtitle.zh: 明确燃烧试验、敷设方式与验收证据

lead.en: Flame-retardant describes limited flame propagation under a defined test; it does not mean fire-resistant circuit integrity or low smoke by itself.
lead.zh: 阻燃表示在规定试验条件下限制火焰蔓延，并不自动等于耐火线路完整性或低烟性能。

intro.en: A useful flame-retardant cable specification names the exact test method, specimen arrangement, flame application, duration and acceptance criteria. IEC 60332 contains different tests for a single insulated wire or cable and for vertically installed bunched cables. Passing one method cannot be translated into every installation.
intro.zh: 有效的阻燃电缆规格必须写明准确试验方法、试样排列、施焰方式、持续时间和判定条件。IEC 60332 包含单根绝缘电线电缆试验，以及垂直安装成束电缆试验。通过其中一种方法，不能直接推导所有安装场景。

title.en: Single cable and bunched cable tests ask different questions
title.zh: 单根与成束试验回答不同问题

copy.en: A single vertical specimen test evaluates flame propagation on one wire or cable under prescribed conditions. A bunched-cable test introduces multiple cables, defined non-metallic volume and ladder arrangements, creating a more severe propagation scenario. Project drawings should state how cables are installed and which method applies. Generic terms such as FR, flame proof or self-extinguishing are not sufficient release criteria.
copy.zh: 单根垂直试样试验用于评估一根电线或电缆在规定条件下的火焰蔓延；成束试验则引入多根电缆、规定的非金属材料体积和梯架排列，形成更严苛的蔓延场景。项目图纸应注明实际敷设方式和适用方法。“FR”“防火”或“自熄”等笼统词语不能作为放行标准。

title.en: Compound, wall thickness and cable geometry work together
title.zh: 材料配方、壁厚与线缆几何共同作用

copy.en: PVC, polyolefin and other compounds can be formulated for flame-retardant behaviour, but the finished result also depends on insulation and jacket thickness, fillers, shield, cable diameter and manufacturing consistency. A resin trade name or additive does not certify the completed cable. Electrical rating, flexibility, abrasion, temperature and chemical resistance still need independent review when the fire formulation changes.
copy.zh: PVC、聚烯烃等材料可以通过配方获得阻燃特性，但成品表现还取决于绝缘和护套壁厚、填充、屏蔽、外径及制造一致性。树脂名称或某一种添加剂不能证明成品电缆合格。改变阻燃配方时，电气额定、柔性、耐磨、温度与化学介质性能仍需分别审核。

title.en: Flame retardancy, fire resistance, smoke and acidity are separate properties
title.zh: 阻燃、耐火、烟密度与酸性气体是不同性能

copy.en: A flame-retardant cable is intended to limit propagation after ignition. A fire-resistant or circuit-integrity cable is evaluated for continued function during a defined fire exposure. Smoke density and halogen-acid gas are covered by separate test families. If a railway, public building, data centre or enclosed equipment project needs several properties, each test and threshold should be written explicitly rather than compressed into one marketing label.
copy.zh: 阻燃电缆用于限制点燃后的火焰蔓延；耐火或线路完整性电缆则评价在规定火灾暴露中继续工作的能力。烟密度和卤酸气体另有独立试验体系。轨道交通、公共建筑、数据中心或封闭设备若同时需要多项性能，应逐项写明试验与限值，不能压缩成一个营销标签。

title.en: Release the exact marking and supporting report
title.zh: 放行准确印字与对应报告

copy.en: The purchase specification should link the cable designation, conductor size, voltage and temperature rating, flame-test method, report or certification reference, production marking and applicable revision. Incoming inspection checks the identity of the supplied cable; assembly inspection preserves spacing, sleeving and routing that may affect the installed fire load. Super Smile records agreed material and process evidence but does not convert a component report into equipment certification.
copy.zh: 采购规格应把线缆型号、导体截面、电压与温度等级、燃烧试验方法、报告或认证编号、生产印字和适用版本关联起来。来料检查确认线材身份，装配检查则保持可能影响安装火载荷的间距、套管与布线。超斯迈尔记录约定的材料和工艺证据，但不会把元件报告等同于整机认证。

inputs.en: Exact IEC 60332 or customer fire-test method and revision
inputs.zh: 准确 IEC 60332 或客户燃烧试验方法与版本

inputs.en: Cable construction, installed grouping and equipment fire strategy
inputs.zh: 线缆结构、安装成束方式与设备防火策略

inputs.en: Required reports, marking, traceability and inspection scope
inputs.zh: 所需报告、印字、追溯与检验范围

q.en: Does flame-retardant mean the cable keeps working in a fire?
q.zh: 阻燃是否表示火灾中仍能工作？

a.en: Not necessarily. Circuit integrity or fire resistance is a different performance claim with a different test method.
a.zh: 不一定。线路完整性或耐火属于另一类性能声明，需要不同试验方法。

title.en: Heavy-Duty High-Voltage Cable
title.zh: 高压重型电线电缆

subtitle.en: Coordinate voltage class, insulation system, termination and installed stress
subtitle.zh: 协同定义电压等级、绝缘体系、端接与安装应力

lead.en: High-voltage cable selection begins with the power system and installation category, not with conductor size or jacket thickness alone.
lead.zh: 高压电缆选型从电力系统与安装类别开始，不能只看导体截面或护套厚度。

intro.en: Rated voltage, system earthing, fault duty, conductor temperature, installation method, short-circuit current and accessories define the cable system. IEC 60502-1 covers certain extruded-insulation power cables for fixed installations at 1 kV and 3 kV, while IEC 60502-2 addresses specified fixed-installation cables from 6 kV to 30 kV. Mobile heavy-duty cables may require a different product standard and project evidence.
intro.zh: 额定电压、系统接地、故障工况、导体温度、安装方式、短路电流与附件共同定义电缆系统。IEC 60502-1 覆盖部分 1 kV 与 3 kV 固定敷设挤包绝缘电力电缆，IEC 60502-2 涉及 6 kV 至 30 kV 的规定固定敷设电缆。移动式重型电缆可能需要不同产品标准和项目证据。

title.en: Define the system voltage and fault conditions
title.zh: 明确系统电压与故障条件

copy.en: Record phase-to-phase and phase-to-earth voltage, AC or DC service, earthing method, expected overvoltage, fault-clearing time and short-circuit current. The same nominal voltage may lead to different insulation and screen requirements in different networks. Equipment, vehicle, renewable-energy and mining applications can use the phrase high voltage differently, so the governing standard and exact voltage designation must appear on the drawing.
copy.zh: 应记录相间与相对地电压、交流或直流、接地方式、预期过电压、故障切除时间和短路电流。相同标称电压在不同网络中可能对应不同绝缘与屏蔽要求。设备、车辆、新能源与矿山对“高压”的定义可能不同，因此图纸必须写明适用标准与准确电压标识。

title.en: Conductor size follows current and thermal installation
title.zh: 导体截面取决于电流与热环境

copy.en: Continuous current, duty cycle, grouping, ambient temperature, ventilation, conduit, tray, soil or free-air installation all change ampacity. Voltage drop and short-circuit withstand provide additional constraints. Flexible high-strand conductors can support motion or service handling, but strand construction must be compatible with lugs and crimp barrels. Thermal calculations should use the exact cable construction and installed route, not a generic ampacity table.
copy.zh: 持续电流、占空比、成束、环境温度、通风、导管、桥架、土壤或空气敷设都会改变载流量，压降与短路耐受又形成额外限制。高股数柔性导体可用于运动或维护操作，但绞线结构必须与接线端子和压接筒兼容。热计算应采用准确线缆结构与安装路径，不能只套用通用载流表。

title.en: Insulation, screen and sheath form one dielectric system
title.zh: 绝缘、屏蔽与护套构成完整介电体系

copy.en: Extruded insulation, semiconductive screens, metallic screen or armour, bedding and outer sheath each have a defined electrical or mechanical role. Clean preparation is critical because cuts, contamination, sharp screen edges and voids concentrate electric stress. Material compatibility with temperature, oil, moisture, UV, abrasion and flame requirements must be confirmed across the complete build. A thicker jacket does not correct an incorrect insulation system.
copy.zh: 挤包绝缘、半导电屏蔽、金属屏蔽或铠装、垫层与外护套分别承担规定的电气或机械作用。备线清洁度非常关键，划伤、污染、尖锐屏蔽边缘和空隙会造成电场集中。整套结构需同时确认温度、油液、潮气、紫外、磨损与阻燃要求的材料相容性；加厚护套不能纠正错误绝缘体系。

title.en: Terminations and joints are part of the cable system
title.zh: 终端与中间接头属于电缆系统

copy.en: Lugs, stress-control components, separable connectors, glands, shields and enclosure interfaces must match conductor, insulation diameter, screen construction and voltage class. Creepage, clearance, sealing, torque, bend radius and support are installation decisions, not cosmetic details. For mobile equipment, connector interlock, touch protection, coding and service sequence may also be safety inputs. Exact accessory part numbers and preparation dimensions belong in controlled work instructions.
copy.zh: 端子、应力控制件、可分离连接器、电缆格兰、屏蔽与机壳界面必须匹配导体、绝缘外径、屏蔽结构和电压等级。爬电距离、电气间隙、密封、扭矩、弯曲半径与支撑都是安装决策，不是外观细节。移动设备还可能需要考虑连接器互锁、防触电、编码和维护顺序。准确附件料号与备线尺寸应写入受控作业文件。

title.en: Inspection and testing must match the project boundary
title.zh: 检验与试验必须匹配项目边界

copy.en: Incoming records confirm cable and accessory identity. Assembly inspection controls preparation, crimping or bolting, shielding, cleaning, torque, sealing and labels. Depending on product standard and project scope, evidence may include conductor resistance, insulation resistance, voltage tests, partial-discharge or sheath tests performed by qualified facilities. The test plan must state whether Super Smile supplies a finished cable assembly, an internal equipment lead or part of a larger field-installed system.
copy.zh: 来料记录用于确认线缆与附件身份；装配检查控制备线、压接或螺栓连接、屏蔽、清洁、扭矩、密封与标签。依据产品标准和项目范围，证据可能包括导体电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压、局部放电或护套试验，并由具备条件的机构实施。试验计划必须说明超斯迈尔交付的是成品电缆组件、设备内部引线，还是更大现场系统的一部分。

inputs.en: System voltage, AC/DC, earthing and fault duty
inputs.zh: 系统电压、交直流、接地与故障工况

inputs.en: Current, route, installation, environment and movement
inputs.zh: 电流、路径、敷设、环境与运动

inputs.en: Cable standard, accessories, endpoints and test plan
inputs.zh: 线缆标准、附件、端点与试验计划

q.en: Can one high-voltage cable construction cover every application?
q.zh: 一种高压电缆结构能否覆盖所有应用？

a.en: No. Fixed power distribution, mobile equipment, vehicles and renewable-energy systems can have different standards, voltage definitions and mechanical duties.
a.zh: 不能。固定配电、移动设备、车辆和新能源系统可能具有不同标准、电压定义与机械工况。

title.en: Shielded Twisted Pair
title.zh: 屏蔽双绞线

subtitle.en: Protect the balanced pair from conductor geometry to enclosure bond
subtitle.zh: 从线对几何到机壳搭接，保护完整平衡通道

lead.en: Twist, impedance, shield construction and termination must remain coordinated across the complete data or instrumentation link.
lead.zh: 绞距、阻抗、屏蔽结构与端接方式必须在完整数据或仪表链路中保持协调。

intro.en: A shielded twisted-pair cable is a balanced transmission structure surrounded by one or more screens. Pair geometry controls differential performance; the screen manages coupling and common-mode current only when its connection to connectors and enclosures is intentional. Cable category, protocol name or foil coverage alone does not define a completed channel.
intro.zh: 屏蔽双绞线是由一对或多对平衡线对及屏蔽层构成的传输结构。线对几何决定差分性能；屏蔽只有在与连接器和机壳形成明确连接时，才能管理耦合与共模电流。线缆类别、协议名称或铝箔覆盖率都不能单独定义完整通道。

title.en: Balanced geometry begins with the pair
title.zh: 平衡性能从线对几何开始

copy.en: Conductor diameter, insulation, center spacing, twist lay and pair uniformity influence impedance, attenuation and balance. Untwisting too far at a connector or changing pair assignment creates a local discontinuity even when every pin is electrically continuous. Industrial Ethernet, single-pair Ethernet, CAN, RS-485, fieldbus and low-level sensor circuits have different physical-layer requirements; the exact protocol and equipment interface must be named.
copy.zh: 导体直径、绝缘、中心距、绞距与线对一致性会影响阻抗、衰减和平衡。连接器处解绞过长或更换线对分配，即使每个针脚都导通，也会造成局部不连续。工业以太网、单对以太网、CAN、RS-485、现场总线和低电平传感器具有不同物理层要求，必须明确准确协议与设备接口。

title.en: Screen notation describes different constructions
title.zh: 屏蔽标识对应不同结构

copy.en: U/FTP, F/UTP, S/FTP and related notations distinguish overall and individual-pair screening. Foil offers broad coverage with low diameter; braid improves mechanical robustness and low-frequency current capacity; combined constructions serve different EMC targets. Coverage percentage alone is not enough. Transfer impedance, coupling attenuation, bend performance, drain wire and connector termination method may be important project inputs.
copy.zh: U/FTP、F/UTP、S/FTP 等标识用于区分总屏蔽与单对屏蔽。铝箔可在较小外径下提供较高覆盖，编织层具有更好的机械稳定性与低频电流能力，复合结构则服务不同 EMC 目标。仅有覆盖率仍不够，转移阻抗、耦合衰减、弯曲性能、排流线与连接器端接方式都可能成为项目输入。

title.en: Connector and enclosure bonding complete the shield path
title.zh: 连接器与机壳搭接闭合屏蔽路径

copy.en: A screen stopped on a long pigtail behaves differently from a low-impedance 360-degree termination. Shielded RJ45, M12, D-sub, circular and custom interfaces each require compatible backshells, clamps or glands. Whether the screen bonds at one end, both ends or through a controlled network depends on frequency, safety, grounding architecture and equipment design. The cable assembly should preserve the customer’s EMC strategy rather than invent one at the workbench.
copy.zh: 屏蔽层通过长引线接地，与低阻抗 360° 环接具有不同高频表现。屏蔽 RJ45、M12、D-sub、圆形与定制接口分别需要兼容后壳、夹具或格兰。屏蔽在单端、双端还是通过受控网络连接，取决于频率、安全、接地架构与设备设计。线缆组件应保持客户的 EMC 策略，而不是在工位上临时决定。

title.en: Routing preserves separation and bend geometry
title.zh: 布线路径保持间距与弯曲几何

copy.en: Maintain separation from motor leads, contactors, drives and other noise sources where the equipment design requires it. Avoid crushing, tight ties, sharp bends and uncontrolled parallel runs. In a moving route, confirm that foil, braid, pair lay and jacket are designed for the motion duty. Cable tray, cabinet entry, shield gland and service loop should be shown on the installation drawing so laboratory performance is not lost during assembly.
copy.zh: 按设备设计要求，与电机线、接触器、变频器和其他噪声源保持间距，避免挤压、过紧扎带、急弯与无控制的长距离平行敷设。运动路径还需确认铝箔、编织、绞距与护套是否适合该运动工况。桥架、柜体入口、屏蔽格兰与维修余量应在安装图中表示，避免实验室性能在装配中丢失。

title.en: Validate the channel, not only continuity
title.zh: 验证完整通道，而不只是导通

copy.en: Continuity and shorts are necessary production checks but cannot prove a high-speed balanced link. Depending on the specified system, evidence may include conductor resistance, resistance unbalance, impedance, insertion loss, return loss, near- and far-end crosstalk, shield continuity or connector shielding effectiveness. IEC 61156 contains cable families for balanced digital communications, while connector-screen tests such as IEC 60512-23-3 address a different boundary. Use the method required by the project.
copy.zh: 导通与短路检查是必要生产项目，却不能证明高速平衡链路。依据系统要求，证据可能包括导体电阻、电阻不平衡、阻抗、插入损耗、回波损耗、近端与远端串扰、屏蔽连续性或连接器屏蔽效能。IEC 61156 覆盖平衡数字通信电缆系列，而 IEC 60512-23-3 等连接器屏蔽试验针对不同边界，应采用项目规定的方法。

inputs.en: Protocol, data rate, impedance and channel length
inputs.zh: 协议、速率、阻抗与通道长度

inputs.en: Pair count, shield notation, connector and bond strategy
inputs.zh: 线对数量、屏蔽标识、接口与搭接策略

inputs.en: Route, motion, noise sources and required channel evidence
inputs.zh: 路径、运动、噪声源与所需通道证据

q.en: Does a shielded cable solve every interference problem?
q.zh: 使用屏蔽线是否能解决所有干扰？

a.en: No. Pair balance, termination, enclosure bonding, routing, grounding and the noise frequency all affect the result.
a.zh: 不能。线对平衡、端接、机壳搭接、布线、接地与噪声频率都会影响结果。

shielded-twisted-pair.keywords: shielded twisted pair, STP cable, U FTP, F UTP, S FTP, industrial Ethernet cable, RS485 cable, CAN twisted pair, single pair Ethernet, shielded data cable, EMC cable assembly

title.en: Halogen-Free Cable
title.zh: 无卤电线电缆

subtitle.en: Separate material composition, gas acidity, smoke and flame performance
subtitle.zh: 分别定义材料组成、气体酸度、烟密度与阻燃性能

lead.en: Halogen-free and LSZH are specification packages, not interchangeable colour or jacket labels.
lead.zh: 无卤与 LSZH 是一组需要明确验证的规格要求，不是可以互换的颜色或护套标签。

intro.en: IEC 60754-1 specifies a method for determining the amount of halogen acid gas evolved during combustion of materials from cables. Smoke density and flame propagation are evaluated by other standards. A project should therefore name the exact gas, smoke and flame requirements instead of assuming one “LSZH” claim proves all three.
intro.zh: IEC 60754-1 规定了电缆材料燃烧时卤酸气体释放量的测定方法；烟密度与火焰蔓延则由其他标准评价。因此项目应分别写明气体、烟密度与阻燃要求，不能假定一个“LSZH”声明同时证明三项性能。

title.en: Halogen content and combustion gas are defined by method
title.zh: 卤素含量与燃烧气体必须按方法定义

copy.en: Halogen-free claims may refer to elemental composition, halogen-acid gas released during combustion, or a customer material restriction. These are related but not identical questions. State the applicable test method, specimen source, threshold and report requirement. Material declarations should identify insulation, jacket, fillers, tapes and printed markings because a complete cable contains more than its outer sheath.
copy.zh: 无卤声明可能指元素组成、燃烧时释放的卤酸气体，或客户材料限制，这些问题相关但并不相同。应写明适用试验方法、取样位置、限值与报告要求。材料声明还应覆盖绝缘、护套、填充、包带和印字，因为完整电缆并不只有外护套。

title.en: Low smoke is a separate visibility requirement
title.zh: 低烟属于独立的能见度要求

copy.en: Smoke-density testing evaluates light transmission under defined combustion conditions. It does not by itself establish halogen content, toxicity, flame propagation or circuit integrity. In rail vehicles, tunnels, public buildings, data centres and enclosed machinery, visibility can be part of the evacuation or maintenance strategy. Specify the exact smoke method and limit alongside, not instead of, the material and flame requirements.
copy.zh: 烟密度试验在规定燃烧条件下评价透光率，并不能单独证明卤素含量、毒性、火焰蔓延或线路完整性。在轨道车辆、隧道、公共建筑、数据中心和封闭机械中，能见度可能属于疏散或维护策略的一部分。应把准确烟密度方法与限值，与材料和阻燃要求并列写出。

title.en: LSZH compounds bring mechanical trade-offs
title.zh: LSZH 配方伴随机械性能取舍

copy.en: Mineral-filled polyolefin compounds are common in low-smoke halogen-free constructions, but compound family and formulation affect flexibility, tear resistance, abrasion, cold bend, oil resistance, extrusion and colour stability. A material suitable for a fixed building cable may not suit a robot, hand-held lead or outdoor harness. Conductor, insulation, filler and jacket must be selected against the complete electrical and mechanical duty.
copy.zh: 矿物填充聚烯烃常用于低烟无卤结构，但材料体系与配方会影响柔性、抗撕裂、耐磨、低温弯曲、耐油、挤出与颜色稳定性。适合固定建筑电缆的材料不一定适合机器人、手持引线或户外线束。导体、绝缘、填充和护套必须结合完整电气与机械工况选择。

title.en: Public transport and enclosed equipment need a property matrix
title.zh: 公共交通与封闭设备需要性能矩阵

copy.en: Rail, marine, building, appliance and industrial projects can call for different combinations of halogen gas, smoke, flame, voltage, temperature, oil, UV and mechanical performance. Do not copy one sector’s specification into another without checking scope. The bill of materials, cable print, supplier declaration and test report should point to the same exact construction and revision so procurement substitutions remain visible.
copy.zh: 轨道、船舶、建筑、电器和工业项目可能要求不同组合的卤酸气体、烟密度、阻燃、电压、温度、耐油、紫外与机械性能。不能未经范围审核就把一个行业的规格复制到另一个行业。BOM、线缆印字、供应商声明与试验报告应指向同一准确结构和版本，让采购替代保持可见。

inputs.en: Exact halogen, acidity, conductivity, smoke and flame methods
inputs.zh: 准确卤素、酸度、电导率、烟密度与阻燃方法

inputs.en: Electrical, temperature, movement and environmental duty
inputs.zh: 电气、温度、运动与环境工况

inputs.en: Cable marking, material declaration and report traceability
inputs.zh: 线缆印字、材料声明与报告追溯

q.en: Does halogen-free automatically mean low smoke and flame-retardant?
q.zh: 无卤是否自动等于低烟和阻燃？

a.en: No. These properties use different test methods and must be specified separately.
a.zh: 不是。这些性能采用不同试验方法，必须分别规定。

halogen-free-cable.keywords: halogen free cable, LSZH cable, low smoke zero halogen, IEC 60754-1, low smoke cable, halogen acid gas test, railway cable, public building cable, flame retardant halogen free wire

title.en: Marine Project Cable
title.zh: 船舶项目电缆

subtitle.en: Map every route from dry accommodation to exposed machinery spaces
subtitle.zh: 从干燥舱室到暴露机械区，逐段定义电缆路径

lead.en: Shipboard power, control and instrumentation cables are selected by circuit, location, fire strategy, environment and class requirements.
lead.zh: 船用动力、控制与仪表电缆应根据回路、位置、防火策略、环境与船级要求选择。

intro.en: IEC 60092-350 provides general construction and test requirements for shipboard power, control and instrumentation cables with specified extruded insulation, primarily for fixed installations including vibration. It does not cover every data, coaxial, optical or frequently flexed marine cable. The vessel, classification society, flag, equipment specification and exact route remain project inputs.
intro.zh: IEC 60092-350 为规定挤包绝缘的船用动力、控制与仪表电缆提供通用结构和试验要求，主要面向包括振动在内的固定安装；它并不覆盖所有数据、同轴、光纤或频繁弯曲船用电缆。船舶、船级社、船旗、设备规范与准确路径仍是项目输入。

title.en: Classify the circuit and route zone
title.zh: 先划分回路与路径区域

copy.en: Separate power, lighting, control, alarm, instrumentation, communication and special circuits. Then map accommodation, control room, engine room, machinery deck, exposed deck and submerged or splash zones. Temperature, vibration, oil, fuel, salt mist, water, UV, mechanical protection and fire exposure differ by location. One cable family rarely answers every route on a vessel or offshore unit.
copy.zh: 应区分动力、照明、控制、报警、仪表、通信与特殊回路，再划分居住区、控制室、机舱、机械甲板、露天甲板以及浸水或飞溅区域。不同位置的温度、振动、油液、燃料、盐雾、水、紫外、机械防护与火灾暴露并不相同，一种线缆系列很少能覆盖整艘船或海上平台的所有路径。

title.en: Salt, oil and moisture reach the interfaces
title.zh: 盐、油与潮气最终都会到达接口

copy.en: Jacket resistance matters, but ingress often begins at glands, connectors, splices, branch seals and damaged supports. Select materials against the actual fluid and temperature, then define drip loops, gland orientation, sealing stack, cable support and service access. Tinned copper, compatible metals and controlled shield termination may reduce corrosion risk, but material names do not replace an assembled-interface validation plan.
copy.zh: 护套耐受性很重要，但进水常从格兰、连接器、接头、分支密封和受损支撑处开始。应依据真实介质与温度选材，并定义滴水弯、格兰方向、密封叠层、电缆支撑与维修空间。镀锡铜、相容金属和受控屏蔽端接可降低腐蚀风险，但材料名称不能代替组件界面验证。

title.en: Engine-room heat and vibration require installed review
title.zh: 机舱热与振动需要按安装状态审核

copy.en: Ambient heat, nearby exhaust or motors, current-generated heat and restricted ventilation can create different conductor temperatures. Vibration and machinery movement load clamps, glands and terminations even when the cable itself is fixed. Confirm support spacing, bend radius, expansion allowance, armour or mechanical protection, and separation from hot surfaces. A standard’s fixed-installation scope should not be presented as proof of frequent-flex life.
copy.zh: 环境热、邻近排气或电机、电流自发热与受限通风会形成不同导体温度。即使线缆固定，振动与机械运动仍会对夹具、格兰和端接施加载荷。应确认支撑间距、弯曲半径、伸缩余量、铠装或机械防护，以及与热表面的隔离。固定安装标准不能被当作频繁弯曲寿命的证明。

title.en: Fire, smoke, halogen and EMC are separate project decisions
title.zh: 阻燃、烟密度、无卤与 EMC 应分别定义

copy.en: Marine projects may specify flame propagation, fire resistance, low smoke, halogen gas, electromagnetic compatibility and circuit segregation. Each property has its own method and acceptance boundary. Instrumentation and communication circuits may need pair, screen and bonding controls in addition to fire performance. The cable schedule should connect every circuit and route to its exact standard, construction, approval evidence and installation note.
copy.zh: 船舶项目可能规定火焰蔓延、耐火、低烟、卤酸气体、电磁兼容与回路隔离，每项性能都有独立方法和验收边界。仪表与通信回路除防火性能外，还可能需要线对、屏蔽与搭接控制。电缆清册应把每条回路和路径连接到准确标准、结构、认可证据与安装说明。

inputs.en: Vessel or platform, class rules, flag and cable schedule
inputs.zh: 船舶或平台、船级规则、船旗与电缆清册

inputs.en: Circuit, route zone, voltage, current and EMC plan
inputs.zh: 回路、路径区域、电压、电流与 EMC 方案

inputs.en: Fire, smoke, halogen, fluids, glands and test evidence
inputs.zh: 防火、烟、无卤、介质、格兰与试验证据

q.en: Does IEC 60092-350 cover every marine cable?
q.zh: IEC 60092-350 是否覆盖所有船用电缆？

a.en: No. Its scope is defined; some data, coaxial, optical and frequently flexed cables require other standards or project specifications.
a.zh: 不是。该标准具有明确范围，部分数据、同轴、光纤和频繁弯曲电缆需要其他标准或项目规范。

marine-project-cable.keywords: marine cable, shipboard cable, IEC 60092-350, marine power cable, marine control cable, marine instrumentation cable, offshore cable, tinned copper marine cable, ship engine room cable

title.en: Medical Project Cable
title.zh: 医疗项目电缆

subtitle.en: Engineer the cable inside the equipment risk-control system
subtitle.zh: 把线缆纳入医疗设备风险控制体系

lead.en: Medical equipment cables connect power, signals, sensors and detachable accessories, but safety and performance belong to the complete equipment system.
lead.zh: 医疗设备电缆连接电源、信号、传感器与可拆附件，但安全与性能属于完整设备系统。

intro.en: IEC 60601-1 addresses basic safety and essential performance of medical electrical equipment. A cable assembly is normally one component within that equipment boundary, not independently “IEC 60601 certified” by appearance or material. The equipment manufacturer’s risk management, applied-part classification, electrical architecture, EMC plan, cleaning method and usability requirements define the cable inputs.
intro.zh: IEC 60601-1 针对医用电气设备的基本安全与基本性能。线缆组件通常只是设备边界内的一个元件，不能凭外观或材料独立宣称“IEC 60601 认证”。设备制造商的风险管理、应用部分分类、电气架构、EMC 方案、清洁方法与可用性要求共同定义线缆输入。

title.en: Start with the equipment and patient boundary
title.zh: 从设备与患者边界开始

copy.en: Identify whether the cable carries mains power, protective earth, isolated power, measurement signals, actuator energy, communications or an applied-part connection. Record accessible conductive parts, connector touch points, isolation barriers and expected connection sequence. Creepage, clearance, leakage current and dielectric requirements are equipment-level safety decisions; the cable drawing must preserve the relevant insulation, pin spacing and protective conductors without claiming the cable alone establishes compliance.
copy.zh: 应识别线缆承载市电、保护接地、隔离电源、测量信号、执行器能量、通信还是应用部分连接，并记录可触及导电部件、连接器触点、隔离屏障与预期插接顺序。爬电距离、电气间隙、漏电流与介电要求属于设备层级安全决策；线缆图纸必须保持相关绝缘、针间距与保护导体，但不能宣称线缆单独建立合规。

title.en: Low-level signals need a defined noise and grounding plan
title.zh: 低电平信号需要明确噪声与接地方案

copy.en: ECG, temperature, pressure, SpO2, imaging, encoder and communication channels may use twisted pairs, coaxial paths, driven shields or controlled grounding. Pair assignment, shield coverage, connector backshell, cable capacitance and flex can influence signal quality. Keep sensitive channels separated from motors, heaters and switching power where the equipment design requires it. EMC evidence belongs to the configured equipment and accessories, not to a generic shielded-cable label.
copy.zh: 心电、温度、压力、血氧、成像、编码器与通信通道可能采用双绞线、同轴、驱动屏蔽或受控接地。线对分配、屏蔽覆盖、连接器后壳、线缆电容与弯曲都会影响信号质量。按设备设计要求，将敏感通道与电机、加热器和开关电源隔离。EMC 证据属于配置完成的设备与附件，而不是一个笼统“屏蔽线”标签。

title.en: Flexibility, touch and cleaning must coexist
title.zh: 柔性、触感与清洁要求必须共存

copy.en: Hand-held probes, foot controls, carts and detachable accessories create repeated bending, pull, rolling and cleaning loads. Jacket choice can affect flexibility, surface friction, stain resistance, plasticizer migration and compatibility with specified disinfectants. Overmoulds, strain reliefs and connector keys should support the real handling sequence. A cleaning claim must name the agent, concentration, contact time and cycle count evaluated by the equipment manufacturer.
copy.zh: 手持探头、脚踏控制、推车与可拆附件会产生重复弯曲、拉扯、滚压和清洁负载。护套选择会影响柔性、表面摩擦、抗污、增塑剂迁移以及与规定消毒剂的相容性。包覆成型、应力释放与连接器防错应支持真实操作顺序。清洁声明必须写明设备制造商评价的清洁剂、浓度、接触时间与循环次数。

title.en: Connector coding supports safe use and service
title.zh: 连接器编码支持安全操作与维护

copy.en: Colour, keying, labels and mechanical incompatibility can reduce incorrect connections, but they must follow the device usability and service plan. Confirm exact mating references, pin view, latching force, retention, insertion cycles and replacement access. Patient-side, operator-side and internal connectors may need different protection. For home healthcare equipment, storage, transport, lay-user handling and environmental assumptions may add requirements beyond a controlled clinical room.
copy.zh: 颜色、防错键、标签与机械不兼容可以降低误插风险，但必须服从设备可用性与维修方案。需要确认准确对插料号、针脚视图、锁紧力、保持力、插拔次数与更换空间。患者侧、操作者侧与内部连接器可能需要不同防护。家庭医疗设备还要考虑储存、运输、非专业用户操作及环境假设。

title.en: Traceability links the assembly to equipment validation
title.zh: 追溯把组件连接到设备验证

copy.en: Controlled records should link cable, connector, terminal and material identities to drawing revision, tooling, crimp or solder criteria, electrical inspection and lot history. First-article approval can include dimensions, pinout, polarity, labels, pull or retention checks and agreed environmental tests. A later material or supplier substitution must be visible to the equipment manufacturer so risk analysis and verification remain valid.
copy.zh: 受控记录应把线材、连接器、端子与材料身份连接到图纸版本、工装、压接或焊接判定、电气检查与批次历史。首件批准可包含尺寸、针脚、极性、标签、拉力或保持力检查及约定环境试验。后续材料或供应商替代必须对设备制造商可见，才能保持风险分析与验证有效。

inputs.en: Equipment function, applied-part and electrical safety boundary
inputs.zh: 设备功能、应用部分与电气安全边界

inputs.en: Signals, power, shielding, flexibility and cleaning protocol
inputs.zh: 信号、电源、屏蔽、柔性与清洁方案

inputs.en: Interface samples, usability controls and validation evidence
inputs.zh: 接口样品、可用性控制与验证证据

q.en: Can a cable assembly be called IEC 60601 certified?
q.zh: 线缆组件能否称为 IEC 60601 认证？

a.en: Normally the standard applies to medical electrical equipment and systems. The cable is specified and controlled as a component within that equipment evaluation.
a.zh: 通常该标准适用于医用电气设备与系统，线缆作为其中元件被规定和控制。

medical-project-cable.keywords: medical cable assembly, medical equipment cable, patient monitor cable, sensor cable, medical device harness, IEC 60601 component, low noise medical cable, cleanable cable, medical connector cable

title.en: Measurement Instrument Cable
title.zh: 测量仪器电缆

subtitle.en: Preserve the measurand from sensor interface to instrument input
subtitle.zh: 从传感接口到仪器输入，保持被测量的真实性

lead.en: Signal level, bandwidth, source impedance, shielding, grounding and connector compensation define the measurement path.
lead.zh: 信号电平、带宽、源阻抗、屏蔽、接地与连接器补偿共同定义测量路径。

intro.en: A measurement cable is part of the measurement system. Thermocouples, RTDs, strain gauges, accelerometers, current probes, oscilloscopes, DAQ modules and precision sensors do not share one universal cable. The assembly can add resistance, capacitance, leakage, triboelectric noise, thermal EMF, attenuation or coupling, so the required uncertainty and bandwidth must be known before construction.
intro.zh: 测量电缆属于测量系统的一部分。热电偶、RTD、应变计、加速度计、电流探头、示波器、DAQ 模块与精密传感器并不共用一种万能线缆。组件可能引入电阻、电容、泄漏、摩擦电噪声、热电势、衰减或耦合，因此必须在设计前明确不确定度与带宽要求。

title.en: Match the cable to the signal source
title.zh: 让线缆匹配信号源

copy.en: Low-resistance RTD circuits, microvolt thermocouples, bridge sensors, charge-output piezoelectric devices and high-speed digital instruments respond differently to cable resistance, capacitance and shielding. Record sensor type, excitation, output range, source impedance, channel bandwidth and instrument input. Extension wire, compensation cable, low-noise coax, triax and twisted-pair constructions are chosen for different error mechanisms; connector appearance is not enough.
copy.zh: 低阻 RTD、微伏级热电偶、电桥传感器、电荷输出压电器件与高速数字仪器对线缆电阻、电容和屏蔽的反应不同。应记录传感器类型、激励、输出范围、源阻抗、通道带宽与仪器输入。补偿导线、低噪声同轴、三同轴与双绞线分别针对不同误差机制，不能只按连接器外观选择。

title.en: Shield, guard and ground are different conductors
title.zh: 屏蔽、保护环与地线承担不同作用

copy.en: A cable shield intercepts electric-field coupling; a guard may be driven near the measured potential to reduce leakage; protective earth and signal reference serve other functions. Combining them without the instrument schematic can increase noise or create unsafe current paths. Define single-ended or differential measurement, shield termination, chassis connection and connector shell relationship. For low-level work, clean insulation surfaces and controlled cable handling can matter as much as nominal shielding coverage.
copy.zh: 屏蔽层用于拦截电场耦合；保护环可被驱动到接近被测电位以降低泄漏；保护接地与信号参考又承担其他作用。脱离仪器原理图随意合并，可能增加噪声或形成不安全电流路径。应明确单端或差分测量、屏蔽端接、机壳连接与连接器外壳关系。低电平测量中，清洁绝缘表面和受控线缆操作可能与屏蔽覆盖同样重要。

title.en: Bandwidth belongs to the complete probe and cable path
title.zh: 带宽属于完整探头与线缆路径

copy.en: Coaxial measurement paths require controlled impedance and suitable connectors; passive oscilloscope probes depend on a compensated divider matched to the instrument input. Cable length, source termination and adapter transitions affect rise time, reflection and amplitude. A continuity pass cannot prove frequency response. Define the connector family, impedance, attenuation ratio, maximum voltage, compensation range and required calibration or verification fixture.
copy.zh: 同轴测量路径需要受控阻抗和合适连接器；无源示波器探头依赖与仪器输入匹配的补偿分压器。线缆长度、源端终端和转接过渡都会影响上升时间、反射与幅度。导通合格不能证明频率响应。应明确连接器家族、阻抗、衰减比、最高电压、补偿范围及所需校准或验证夹具。

title.en: Motion and temperature can create measurement error
title.zh: 运动与温度也会制造测量误差

copy.en: Repeated flexing can change capacitance, generate triboelectric charge or fatigue shields and conductors. Temperature gradients across dissimilar metals can create thermoelectric voltages; long sensor routes can add resistance and pickup. Specify stationary, occasional-flex or continuous-motion duty, minimum bend radius, temperature zones and strain relief. Low-noise cable claims should be checked against the sensor and actual handling environment.
copy.zh: 重复弯曲会改变电容、产生摩擦电荷，或使屏蔽与导体疲劳。异种金属之间的温度梯度会产生热电势，较长传感器路径会增加电阻与耦合。应规定固定、偶尔弯曲或连续运动工况、最小弯曲半径、温区与应力释放。低噪声线缆声明必须结合传感器和真实操作环境判断。

title.en: Calibrate the configured system and control substitutions
title.zh: 校准实际配置，并控制替代

copy.en: Calibration establishes the performance of a defined instrument, sensor, lead, adapter and setup. Replacing cable length, connector material or wiring topology can change that configuration. Production records should preserve part numbers, pinout, polarity, shield treatment, length and inspection evidence. Where cable contribution is significant, include it in system calibration or an agreed comparison fixture rather than treating every electrically continuous lead as equivalent.
copy.zh: 校准建立在规定仪器、传感器、引线、适配器与设置之上。更换线长、连接器材料或接线拓扑会改变该配置。生产记录应保持料号、针脚、极性、屏蔽处理、长度与检验证据。若线缆影响显著，应把它纳入系统校准或约定比对夹具，而不能把所有导通的引线视为等同。

inputs.en: Sensor, signal range, source and instrument input
inputs.zh: 传感器、信号范围、信号源与仪器输入

inputs.en: Bandwidth, accuracy, impedance, shield and grounding plan
inputs.zh: 带宽、精度、阻抗、屏蔽与接地方案

inputs.en: Length, motion, temperature, connectors and calibration boundary
inputs.zh: 长度、运动、温度、接口与校准边界

q.en: Is continuity testing enough for an instrument cable?
q.zh: 仪器电缆只做导通测试是否足够？

a.en: No. Depending on the measurement, resistance, capacitance, leakage, impedance, noise, polarity or frequency response may be relevant.
a.zh: 不够。依据测量类型，电阻、电容、泄漏、阻抗、噪声、极性或频率响应都可能相关。

title.en: Outdoor Cable
title.zh: 户外电缆

subtitle.en: Design for sunlight, water, temperature and the actual installation route
subtitle.zh: 围绕日照、水、温度与真实安装路径进行设计

lead.en: Outdoor suitability comes from the complete cable, interfaces, supports and exposure profile—not from a black jacket alone.
lead.zh: 户外适用性来自完整线缆、接口、支撑与暴露谱，而不是一层黑色护套。

intro.en: An outdoor cable may face solar UV, heat, cold, rain, condensation, standing water, wind movement, ice, abrasion, animals, chemicals and lightning-related transients. Above-ground, conduit, tray, rooftop, direct-buried, solar, antenna and mobile installations require different constructions and installation rules. State the exact listing, standard or customer qualification required by the destination market.
intro.zh: 户外电缆可能面对太阳紫外、热、冷、雨、凝露、积水、风致运动、结冰、磨损、动物、化学介质与雷电瞬态。架空、导管、桥架、屋顶、直埋、光伏、天线与移动安装需要不同结构与安装规则。应明确目标市场要求的准确认证、标准或客户验证。

title.en: Map UV, heat and cold over the complete route
title.zh: 绘制全路径的紫外、热与低温

copy.en: Rooftops and exposed metalwork can run hotter than ambient air, while winter installation and wind chill challenge cold bend and impact performance. Carbon-black or stabilised compounds can improve UV resistance, but compound formulation, wall thickness and test evidence matter. Record continuous and peak temperature, solar exposure, colour, installation season and expected life. A material name such as PVC, PE or PUR does not define outdoor durability by itself.
copy.zh: 屋顶与暴露金属表面的温度可能高于环境空气，而冬季安装与风冷又会考验低温弯曲和冲击性能。炭黑或稳定剂可改善耐紫外性，但配方、壁厚与试验证据同样重要。应记录持续和峰值温度、日照、颜色、安装季节与预期寿命；PVC、PE 或 PUR 等材料名称不能单独定义户外耐久性。

title.en: Water exposure must include every interface
title.zh: 进水评估必须覆盖每一处接口

copy.en: Rain, spray, condensation, temporary immersion and permanent submersion are different conditions. Water can enter at cut ends, glands, connector seals, splices, branches or damaged jacket and then migrate along conductors. Define mating state, orientation, drainage, drip loops, cable entry direction and pressure or immersion method. An IP rating on one connector does not automatically transfer to the complete cable assembly or enclosure.
copy.zh: 雨淋、喷溅、凝露、短时浸水与长期水下属于不同条件。水可能从切口、格兰、连接器密封、接头、分支或护套损伤处进入，并沿导体迁移。应定义插合状态、方向、排水、滴水弯、进线方向以及压力或浸水方法。单个连接器的 IP 等级不会自动转移到完整电缆组件或机壳。

title.en: Route and support resist wind, abrasion and movement
title.zh: 路径与支撑用于抵抗风、磨损与运动

copy.en: Cable weight, span, wind movement, ice, vibration and thermal expansion load supports and terminations. Specify tray, clips, catenary support, conduit, burial depth or mechanical guards as applicable. Preserve minimum bend radius and avoid sharp roof edges, standing water and unsupported connector loads. Flexible outdoor equipment leads and fixed outdoor wiring are different product categories; use the construction approved for the actual installation.
copy.zh: 线缆重量、跨距、风致运动、结冰、振动与热胀冷缩都会对支撑和端接施加载荷。应按需规定桥架、夹具、承力件、导管、埋深或机械护板，保持最小弯曲半径，避开尖锐屋面边缘、积水与无支撑连接器载荷。户外柔性设备引线与固定户外布线属于不同产品类别，必须使用适合实际安装的结构。

title.en: Electrical design includes temperature, voltage drop and transients
title.zh: 电气设计还包括温度、压降与瞬态

copy.en: Ampacity changes with ambient temperature, grouping, conduit, burial and solar heating. Long outdoor runs make voltage drop important, while communication and sensor links may need surge, grounding or shield coordination. Separation from lightning protection, power circuits and other services follows the site design. Cable selection cannot replace equipment-level overcurrent, surge and bonding protection.
copy.zh: 载流量会随环境温度、成束、导管、埋设与太阳加热而变化，长距离户外路径还会放大压降问题；通信与传感器链路可能需要协调浪涌、接地与屏蔽。与防雷系统、电力回路和其他设施的间距应服从现场设计。线缆选型不能代替设备层级的过流、浪涌与搭接保护。

title.en: Verify the exact outdoor construction and installation
title.zh: 验证准确户外结构与安装状态

copy.en: Release records should identify conductor, insulation, jacket, fillers, armour or shield, printing, connectors, seals and applicable standard. Inspection checks jacket damage, bend, support, connector orientation, labels and sealing workmanship. Depending on scope, agreed evidence may address UV, temperature cycling, water ingress, insulation, voltage, pull or flex. Field-installed systems still require competent installation and equipment-level verification after the cable leaves the factory.
copy.zh: 放行记录应标识导体、绝缘、护套、填充、铠装或屏蔽、印字、连接器、密封与适用标准。检查项目包括护套损伤、弯曲、支撑、连接器方向、标签与密封工艺。依据范围，约定证据可涉及紫外、温度循环、进水、绝缘、耐压、拉力或弯曲。线缆出厂后，现场系统仍需合格安装与设备层级验证。

inputs.en: Route type, sun, temperature, rain, water and movement
inputs.zh: 路径类型、日照、温度、雨水、浸水与运动

inputs.en: Circuit, voltage, current, length, shield and surge strategy
inputs.zh: 回路、电压、电流、长度、屏蔽与浪涌方案

inputs.en: Required listing, connectors, sealing and field installation
inputs.zh: 所需认证、接口、密封与现场安装

q.en: Is every black cable suitable outdoors?
q.zh: 所有黑色线缆都适合户外吗？

a.en: No. Colour alone does not prove UV, water, temperature, mechanical or installation suitability.
a.zh: 不是。颜色本身不能证明耐紫外、防水、温度、机械或安装适用性。

outdoor-cable.keywords: outdoor cable, UV resistant cable, weather resistant cable, rooftop cable, direct burial cable, water resistant cable, solar cable, antenna cable, outdoor wiring, outdoor cable assembly
